description: Absolute memory budget ceilings for memcheck regression gating. Single source of truth consumed by cargo xtask memcheck and CI. Tightened to C-phase band after Plan 3 worker-aware memory accounting. Combined ceilings apply to main+worker RSS during worker-active phases.
tolerance_note: baseline_tolerance_pct widened 5 -> 10 (T8a, memory-pressure remediation). The box-idle RSS baseline is noisy under swap saturation: on bb76392e embed_idle measured 8020 KiB against a 7576 baseline +5% (7955) and flaked. 10% absorbs sub-10% jitter while still failing a genuine >10% regression.

mcp_idle_proliferation.description: T8 step-3: combined RSS of 3 concurrent idle MCP servers. 307200 KiB (300 MiB) = 3x the 100 MiB single-server idle ceiling; catches gross per-server leaks. The tight linearity guard (combined <= 3.5x single) lives in harness_integration.rs::test_mcp_idle_proliferation_linearity.

worker_ort_threads.description: T8 step-3: main daemon capped at 100 MiB during the worker-active trigger under LEINDEX_WORKER_ORT_THREADS=1. Combined ceiling 4 GiB leaves headroom for the opt-in {0,4,1} comparison run (LEINDEX_MEMCHECK_EXPENSIVE=1); the phase's own baseline is captured with the capped setting.

stale_artifacts.description: T8 step-3: RSS of the `leindex cleanup --stale-daemons` sweep command against seeded dead-pid sidecars (100 MiB ceiling; measured value is a few MB). Removal of every seeded sidecar is asserted in-phase and in harness_integration.rs::test_stale_artifacts_phase_removes_dead_sidecars.
